e.title_en: A replication package that reconciles three classes of source, an insurer open data release, national government crash statistics, and prosecutors investigation records, for two Mexican states over five years: it describes itself in writing as a replication package for an observability audit of an insurer, a government crash register, and a prosecutors office, states its scope as two states between 2019 and 2023, lists the four public sources with the transparency-platform file numbers and official letter identifiers under which the prosecutors records were obtained, states in writing that none of them contains personal data, and carries an MIT licence.

e.summary_en: This is a replication package that reconciles three classes of road-crash record, describing itself in writing as a replication package for an observability audit of an insurer, a government crash register, and a prosecutors office. **Measured this round**: created and pushed on the tenth of September, a repository of about nine megabytes in Python, an MIT licence, no stars, and a description of about four kilobytes over eighty-one lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language and was reached through the Spanish word for crash claims.** **Four things are worth reading: two of the three source classes are published open data while the third was obtained by formal request, and the file number, official letter identifier, and case number are printed so that how the material was obtained can be checked by a third party; the description states in writing that none of the sources contains personal data and that the prosecutors records identify cases only by unit, date, offence, and municipality; the scripts are numbered from one to eight with an explicit statement that two earlier scripts are superseded because the geographic cut changed from a coordinate rectangle to an urban polygon and are kept only for comparison, so the current results come from script eight; and the eight statistical decision points that must be confirmed before submission are gathered into a separate document that the description tells the reader to open first.** **None of the scripts was run and none of the numbers was re-derived this round.**
e.body:
**tres-fuentes-tamaulipas**（`antoniobarreda-glitch/tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`）**是一份**把**三类**道路事故**记录对齐核查**的**复现包****——**逐字自述为**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**，**范围逐字为**「**Tamaulipas y Nuevo León, 2019–2023**」**，**并**逐字说明**它**是**为**投稿 **ICSC-CITIES 2026** 的**手稿**准备的**合作材料**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**用母语关键词找项目**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三类来源的取得方式被逐字写明，**其中一类是**依法申请****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出四类来源**：**AXA／I2DS 开放数据**（**逐字**：**保险公司**通过**国际数据科学研究所**发布的**开放数据**）**、**INEGI 的 **ATUS**（**城市与城郊**陆路交通事故统计）**、**两州检察机关**的**办案记录**（**逐字注明**经**国家透明平台**申请取得，**并逐字给出**卷宗号 **`811197026000256`**、**公函号 **`FGJ/DGAJDH/IP/12551/2026`**、**案号 **`SAI/314/2026`****）**、**以及 **INEGI **EDR** 死亡登记**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**最值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**「**数据**」**这个词**下面**，**来源**至少**有三类**：**企业**自愿**公开的**、**政府**例行**统计的**、**以及**只能**依法**申请**才能**拿到的****——**⭐ 而**把**取得路径与**文号**写出来**，**是**让**结果**可复核**的**前提**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**的**论文**用了**非公开**来源**（**监管报表、**理赔明细）**，**则**把**申请路径**写清**，**比**只写**「**数据来自**某机构**」**有用**得多**。

**⭐⭐ ② 隐私口径逐字声明****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**写**「**Las cuatro fuentes son públicas y ninguna contiene datos personales.**」**，**并**逐字说明**办案记录**的**标识方式**（**逐字**：**按**单位、**日期、**罪名与**市镇**，**不含**受害者**可识别信息**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实转述**这一声明**，**⚠️ 但**不**据此**认定**其**合规性**（**⭐ 合规判断**不**是**本词条**能做的**）**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 脚本的**版本关系**被**明说****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**脚本 **01 至 08** 的**产出**，**并**逐字注明 **04 与 **05** 是**「**旧版**」**（**逐字**：**当时**用的是**坐标矩形**而**不是**城市多边形）**，**逐字**：**「**Se conservan para poder comparar, pero los resultados vigentes son los de 08.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**复现包**的**好习惯**：**⭐ 即**旧脚本**不删**、**但**标明**哪一份**才是**现行结果**——**⭐ 而**这**正好**避免**「**后来者**跑了**旧脚本**、**得出**旧结论**」。

**⭐⭐ ④ 提交前的**统计决定**被**单列**且**逐条**等待确认****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字要求**「**Lee PROCESSOS.pdf. Recorre el pipeline paso a paso y marca en rojo los ocho puntos donde hay una decisión estadística que debe confirmarse antes del envío, con la pregunta concreta en cada uno.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这是**本轮**最值得**其他项目**学的**一条**：**⭐ 即**把**「**这一步**为什么**这样选**」**从**代码注释**里**提出来**，**变成**一份**待确认清单**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**论文**或**模型**交付前**，**列出**所有**统计选择点**（**口径、**剔除规则、**分层、**去重、**基准）**并**逐条**确认**，**通常**比**再调一次**模型**更能**提高**结论的**可信度**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交付物清单与范围限制****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**目录逐字含** `datos/tamaulipas`（**六城市的**三类来源**＋**已按**城市／**城郊**分层的 **`estratos_*.csv`** ＋**每城市、**每分辨率的 **H3 网格）**、`datos/nuevo_leon`（**州检察机关**完整回复**与**六市镇**汇总）**、`datos/inegi`（**死亡率校验、**城市 **AGEB、**合并后的**城市多边形 **`.gpkg`（**逐字注明**可用 **QGIS** 打开）**）**、`resultados/`（**主表逐字为 **`matriz_urbano.csv`**、**结构性下限表 **`pisos_urbano.csv`**、**城郊汇总 **`periurbano_resumen.csv`****）**、`scripts/`（**01 至 08**）**；**⭐ 并逐字写明**范围限制**「**este paquete contiene únicamente datos de Tamaulipas y Nuevo León**」**（**不**含**其他五地**）**；**⭐ 依赖逐字**为 **pandas、**numpy、**h3、**scipy、**geopandas、**shapely、**openpyxl****。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[japan-claims-review-archive]] 是**同一形态**（**一份**可引用的**可复现归档**）**，**[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 覆盖**理赔数据的**分析**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**保险公司的**开放数据**与**政府统计、**司法记录**放在**同一坐标系里**核对**」这一**做法**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **写清**每一类来源**的**取得路径**（**含**申请文号**）**；**② **四类来源**里**谁**含**个人信息**要**先声明**；**③ **旧脚本**保留但**标明**谁**是**现行版**；**④ **把**统计决定点**做成**待确认清单**；**⑤ **分层**（**城市／**城郊）**要**有**依据**（**本条用**城市多边形**与 **H3 网格**）**；**⑥ **数据**对外发布前**想好**可引用**（**本条**逐字提到**将来**接 **Zenodo** 取 **DOI**）**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其任何脚本**（**未安装 **pandas／**geopandas／**h3**、**未下载**其数据**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何数字**、**不主张**其**结论**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **`PROCESOS.pdf`**、**未读**其脚本内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**隐私声明**是否**符合**墨西哥**或**任何辖区**的**法律要求**（**⭐ 本词条**只**转述**作者**自己的声明**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**该手稿**是否**已被 **ICSC-CITIES 2026** 接收**、**也**未核实**其**同行评审状态**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**保险公司开放数据**的**授权范围**是否**允许**本复现包**再分发**（**⭐ 本条**只**按**其**逐字来源**记录**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**H3 网格**与**城市／城郊分层**的**阈值**选择依据**（**⭐ 逐字提示**读者**去看**那**八点清单**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该复现包**是**研究方法材料**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**法律意见**。
e.body_hk:
**tres-fuentes-tamaulipas**（`antoniobarreda-glitch/tres-fuentes-tamaulipas`）**是一份**把**三類**道路事故**記錄對齊核查**的**復現包****——**逐字自述為**「**Paquete de replicación — auditoría de observabilidad AXA / ATUS / Fiscalía**」**，**範圍逐字為**「**Tamaulipas y Nuevo León, 2019–2023**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**用母語關鍵詞找項目**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 三類來源的取得方式被逐字寫明，**其中一類依法申請****——**四類來源逐字為**：**AXA／I2DS 開放數據**（**保險公司**經**國際數據科學研究所**發布**）**、**INEGI 的 ATUS**、**兩州檢察機關辦案記錄**（**逐字附**卷宗號 **`811197026000256`**、**公函號 **`FGJ/DGAJDH/IP/12551/2026`**、**案號 **`SAI/314/2026`****）**、**INEGI EDR 死亡登記**；**⭐ 即**數據至少有**三類**：**企業自願公開、**政府例行統計、**依法申請取得**——**寫出取得路徑與文號**是**可複核的前提**。

**⭐⭐ ② 隱私口徑逐字聲明****——**逐字**「**Las cuatro fuentes son públicas y ninguna contiene datos personales.**」**，**並逐字說明**辦案記錄**只按**單位、**日期、**罪名與**市鎮**標識**；**本詞條**只轉述**作者聲明**，**不**據此**認定**合規性**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 腳本的版本關係被明說****——**逐字**「**Se conservan para poder comparar, pero los resultados vigentes son los de 08.**」**（**04 與 05** 為**舊版**：**坐標矩形**而非**城市多邊形**）**；**⭐ 即**舊腳本不刪**、**但標明誰是現行版**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 提交前的統計決定被單列****——**逐字**「**Lee PROCESSOS.pdf. Recorre el pipeline paso a paso y marca en rojo los ocho puntos donde hay una decisión estadística que debe confirmarse antes del envío, con la pregunta concreta en cada uno.**」**；**⭐ 即**把**「**為什麼這樣選**」**從代碼註釋**變成**待確認清單**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交付物與範圍限制****——**目錄逐字含** `datos/tamaulipas`（**三類來源＋**分層 `estratos_*.csv`＋**H3 網格**）、`datos/nuevo_leon`、`datos/inegi`（**含 `.gpkg`，逐字註明可用 QGIS 打開**）、`resultados/`（**主表 `matriz_urbano.csv`**、**`pisos_urbano.csv`**、**`periurbano_resumen.csv`**）、`scripts/`（**01 至 08**）**；**範圍逐字**「**este paquete contiene únicamente datos de Tamaulipas y Nuevo León**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[japan-claims-review-archive]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把保險公司開放數據與政府統計、**司法記錄放在同一坐標系核對**」**這一做法**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **寫清每類來源的取得路徑**；**② **先聲明哪類含個人信息**；**③ **舊腳本標明誰是現行版**；**④ **統計決定點做成待確認清單**；**⑤ **分層要有依據**；**⑥ **發布前想好可引用（**Zenodo 取 DOI**）**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有運行**其任何腳本**，**不主張**其任何數字與結論**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 `PROCESOS.pdf` 與腳本內容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其隱私聲明是否符合任何轄區法律要求**（**只轉述作者聲明**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**該手稿是否已被 ICSC-CITIES 2026 接收**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其保險公司開放數據的授權範圍是否允許再分發**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其 H3 與分層閾值的選擇依據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該復現包是研究方法材料**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**法律意見**。
e.body_en:
This is a replication package that reconciles three classes of road-crash record for two Mexican states over five years, describing itself in writing as a replication package for an observability audit of an insurer, a government crash register, and a prosecutors office, and stating in writing that it is material prepared for co-authors of a manuscript submitted to a conference. **This entry belongs to the round theme of finding projects through keywords in their own language.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, how each class of source was obtained is stated in writing, and one of them was obtained by formal request.** The four sources are open data released by an insurer through an international data science institute, the national crash statistics programme, prosecutors investigation records obtained through the national transparency platform with the file number, official letter identifier, and case number printed, and the national death registry. **Under the single word data there are at least three kinds of source: voluntarily published corporate data, routine government statistics, and material that can only be obtained by formal request, and writing out the acquisition path with its official identifiers is what makes results checkable. If a dissertation uses non-public sources such as regulatory filings or claim records, recording the request path is far more useful than saying only that the data came from an institution.**

**Second, the privacy position is stated in writing.** The description says the four sources are public and none contains personal data, and explains that investigation files are identified only by unit, date, offence, and municipality without identifying details of victims. **This entry transcribes that statement and does not treat it as a compliance finding, since compliance is not something this entry can establish.**

**Third, the relationship between script versions is made explicit.** The scripts run from one to eight, and two earlier ones are labelled as superseded because the geographic cut changed from a coordinate rectangle to an urban polygon; they are kept for comparison while the current results come from script eight. **Keeping old scripts without deleting them while marking which one produced the current results is a good habit, because it is exactly what stops a later reader from running the old script and reporting the old conclusion.**

**Fourth, the statistical decisions that must be confirmed before submission are gathered into a single document.** The description instructs the reader to work through the pipeline step by step and mark in red the eight points where a statistical decision needs confirmation before submission, with the concrete question attached to each. **Lifting the why of each choice out of code comments into a confirmation checklist is the most transferable practice of this round, because listing every statistical choice such as definitions, exclusion rules, stratification, deduplication, and benchmarks and confirming them one by one usually raises the credibility of a conclusion more than another round of modelling does.**

**Fifth, the deliverables and the scope limits are stated.** The directory holds the three source classes for six cities together with stratified tables and hexagonal grid cells per city and resolution, the full response of the second state prosecutors office with a summary of six municipalities, national validation and urban polygon geometry files that open in a geographic information system, result tables headed by a main urban matrix, a structural floor table, and a peri-urban summary, and the numbered scripts. **The scope limit is stated in writing: the package contains data for two states only and not the other five regions belonging to other lines of the project.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: a pooled entry is the same form of citable reproducibility archive and another covers claims-data analytics, **while this entry supplies the practice of checking an insurer open data release against government statistics and judicial records inside one coordinate system. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: record the acquisition path of every source including official request identifiers; state which sources contain personal information before anyone asks; keep old scripts but mark which is current; turn statistical decisions into a confirmation checklist; justify stratification rather than asserting it; and plan for citability, as this package states its intention to attach a persistent identifier once the manuscript is published.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, none of the scripts was run**, no dependencies were installed and no data was downloaded, **so no claim is made about any figure or conclusion**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the accompanying process document or the scripts. **Third, whether the privacy statement satisfies the legal requirements of any jurisdiction was not verified**, only the author own statement being transcribed. **Fourth, whether the manuscript has been accepted by the conference named in the description was not verified, nor was its peer review status. Fifth, whether the licence of the insurer open data release permits redistribution in this package was not verified. Sixth, the basis for the hexagonal grid and the stratification thresholds was not verified, the description itself directing the reader to the eight-point checklist. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the package is research method material rather than an insurance product or a legal opinion.**
